name: Sini
overview: Sini is a male figure briefly mentioned in the Bible as a son of Canaan. His lineage places him within the early genealogies found in Genesis, specifically in the Table of Nations. Beyond his identification as a son of Canaan, Scripture provides no additional details about his tribe or personal history.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Sini' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:17. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to this name in the biblical text, indicating it serves primarily as an identifier within the genealogical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Sini as a son of Canaan, making him part of the Canaanite lineage. No other family relationships or descendants are mentioned beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Sini's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical account of Genesis 10, which traces the descendants of Noah's sons and outlines the origins of various peoples. As a son of Canaan, Sini contributes to the biblical understanding of the Canaanite nations that later play a role in the history of Israel. Though briefly noted, his mention helps establish the broader context of post-flood human settlement and lineage.
